metaDescription: Field-tested Roblox automation scripts. Browse the archive, get a script, deploy it.

announcement.text: New script dropping soon — watch the Discord for details.

hero.lede: Every script in this archive has logged real matches before release — automation built to survive patches, not just demos.

pillars.title: Actively maintained
pillars.description: Patches ship within days of a game update, not weeks — nothing sits broken for long.

pillars.title: Community-driven
pillars.description: Feature requests and new scripts come straight from the Discord, not a boardroom.

pillars.title: Free, always
pillars.description: No paywalls, no premium tiers. Every script in the archive is free to use.

fieldReport.paragraph1: TITANIC HUB is built and maintained independently. Nothing here ships until it's been run through real sessions — farming loops, combat routines, and menus get rebuilt whenever a game update breaks them, instead of being left to rot.
fieldReport.paragraph2: Requests, bug reports, and patch notes all move through the Discord — it's the fastest way to know when a script updates.

faq.question: Are these scripts free?
faq.answer: Yes — every script in the archive is free to use. Joining the Discord helps support ongoing development, but it's never required.

faq.question: Will using a script get my account banned?
faq.answer: Any third-party script carries some risk. Use your own judgment, and consider testing on an account you're not attached to before running anything on a main.

faq.question: How do I install a script?
faq.answer: Open a script's page, copy it, paste it into your executor, and run it. Each script page has the exact steps.

faq.question: Can I request a script for a specific game?
faq.answer: Drop a request in the Discord. New scripts get prioritized based on community interest.

sections.heading: No affiliation
sections.body: TITANIC HUB is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Roblox Corporation, the developers of any game referenced on this site, or any executor listed on the Executors page.

sections.heading: Use at your own risk
sections.body:
Scripts on this site interact with third-party games in ways their developers did not intend. Using them may violate the terms of service of Roblox and of individual games, and can result in warnings, restrictions, or bans on your account — up to and including permanent termination. That risk is entirely yours. If you're not comfortable with it, don't run the scripts.

We'd suggest testing on an account you're not attached to before running anything on a main, though even that isn't a guarantee.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: Everything in the archive is provided "as is," with no warranty of any kind, express or implied — including, without limitation, warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement. We don't guarantee any script will work, keep working, or be free of bugs, and we don't guarantee it's compatible with any specific executor.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, TITANIC HUB and anyone involved in maintaining it are not liable for any damages or losses arising from your use — or inability to use — anything on this site. That includes account bans, data loss, device issues, or any other direct or indirect damages.

sections.heading: Third-party executors
sections.body: Executors listed on this site are built and maintained by separate, independent developers. We don't control their code, their update schedule, or their safety practices. Listing an executor here isn't a guarantee that it's safe — always get executors from their official source and use your own judgment.

sections.heading: Changes to this disclaimer
sections.body: This page may be updated as the project changes. Continued use of the site after an update means you accept the current version.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about any of this go through Discord — it's the fastest way to reach us.
